# Ligonier Learning

> > Reformed theological education featuring biblical studies, church history, and practical Christian living from a Calvinist perspective.

Learn.ligonier.org provides articles, commentary recommendations, and theological resources grounded in Westminster Confession theology. Content covers Scripture exposition, Reformed doctrine, historical figures like John Calvin and Pierre Viret, and practical application of biblical truth to contemporary Christian life.

## Key Topics

- Reformed Theology
- Westminster Confession of Faith
- John Calvin
- Biblical Studies
- Justification & Salvation
- Eschatology & Last Things
- Old Testament Prophets
- Christian Living
- Theological Literacy
- Church History
- Sacramental Theology
- Union with Christ
- Evangelism & Missions
- Biblical Decision-Making
- Assurance of Salvation

## Reformed Theology & Doctrine

- [The Essence of the Calvinistic Life](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/essence-calvinistic-life): Ferguson on Reformed theology, God's sovereignty & Westminster Catechism
- [Has the Church Misunderstood Justification?](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/has-church-misunderstood-justification): Waters critiques N.T. Wright's New Perspective on Paul & justification
- [Evidences of Assurance](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/evidences-assurance): Thomas on Westminster Confession's teaching on assurance of salvation
- [John Calvin on Theological Trespassing](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/john-calvin-theological-trespassing): Calvin on Deut 29:29 & theological boundaries in divine revelation
- [What's Our Theological Temperature?](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/state-theology-whats-our-theological-temperature): Nichols & Lifeway Research survey on theological literacy in the church

## Biblical Studies & Theology

- [5 Things You Should Know About Hell](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/5-things-hell): Garriott on eternal punishment, annihilationism & Westminster Confession
- [How Is Jesus the True Vine?](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/how-is-jesus-true-vine): John 15:1 'I am' saying, union with Christ & Israel's vine metaphor
- [3 Things You Should Know About Daniel](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/3-things-daniel): Daniel's role in OT prophecy & restoration themes in Babylonian exile
- [Who Was Mary?](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/who-was-mary): Reformed perspective on Mary, mother of Jesus & Catholic-Protestant views

## Christian Living & Spiritual Growth

- [5 Things You Should Know About Evangelism](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/5-things-evangelism): Essential role of evangelism, Holy Spirit & missions in church purpose
- [5 Things You Should Know About Biblical Decision-Making](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/5-things-decision-making): Scripture guidance, prayer & wisdom in Christian decision-making process
- [A Resolution for the Christian Life](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/a-resolution-for-the-christian-life): Ferguson on Paul's Philippians 3 & knowing Christ as life resolution
- [Why Do We Need Community?](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/why-do-we-need-community): Murray on loneliness epidemic & importance of Christian fellowship today
- [The Freedom to Be Yourself: Personhood in Marriage](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/personhood-in-marriage): Biblical individuality & personhood strengthen Christian marriage unity

## Recommended Reading & Commentary Guides

- [Recommended Reading: Doctrine of the Last Things](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/doctrine-last-things-recommended-reading): Mathison's eschatology reading list: Bavinck, Horton, Venema, Hoekema
- [Recommended Reading: Doctrine of Lord's Supper](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/doctrine-lords-supper-recommended-reading): Mathison's sacramental theology reading: Letham, Calvin, Gerrish, Wallace
- [Top 5 Commentaries on the Book of Jeremiah](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/top-5-commentaries-jeremiah): Mathison recommends Thompson, Kaiser, Rata on Jeremiah's fall of Judah
- [Top 5 Commentaries on the Book of Zephaniah](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/top-5-commentaries-zephaniah): Commentary recommendations for Zephaniah, minor prophet during Josiah
- [5 Recommended Resources for Back to School](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/recommended-resources-back-to-school): Student resources: Reformation Study Bible & worldview tools for youth

## Church History & Historical Figures

- [Who was Pierre Viret?](https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/who-was-pierre-viret): Viret, 'Smile of the Reformation' & Swiss reformer's legacy in Geneva
